newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish Life 4-mth new business up 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Irish Life 4-mth new business up 10 pct.

text.p: Irish Life Plc said on Thursday that its new business sales for the first four months were up 10 percent on the same period last year.

"In group terms our sales performance for the period so far this year has been very encouraging with total sales up 10 percent on a weighted premium basis compared to the first four months of 1996," chairman Conor McCarthy said in a statement.
McCarthy told shareholders at an annual meeting that the United States division had a very encouraging start to the year.
"New business sales in our existing businesses are running 34 percent ahead of the position for the same period last year," McCarthy said.
He said new business in Ireland rose three percent despite an ongoing labour dispute in the Field Force division of the Irish retail operation.
